title: CSA Certification Practice Test
description: Comprehensive practice test for PEGA Certified System Architect exam. 60 questions covering all exam topics.

questions.question: What is the primary purpose of a Case Type in PEGA?
options: To represent a business transaction or process
questions.explanation: A Case Type represents a business transaction or process from start to finish. It defines the lifecycle of work as it moves through various stages and processes.

questions.question: Which rule type is used to define business logic in PEGA?
questions.explanation: PEGA uses multiple rule types for business logic: Flow Rules for process flows, Decision Rules for decision logic, and Declare Expressions for calculations and derived values.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a Data Page in PEGA?
options: To cache and manage data efficiently
questions.explanation: Data Pages are used to cache and manage data efficiently. They load data once and reuse it, improving application performance.

questions.question: In PEGA, what does SLA stand for?
questions.explanation: SLA stands for Service Level Agreement. It defines goals and deadlines for completing work within a case.

questions.question: Which studio is recommended for business users to build applications?
questions.explanation: App Studio is designed for business users and system architects to build applications with a simplified interface.

questions.question: What is the purpose of a Flow rule?
options: To orchestrate the sequence of steps in a process
questions.explanation: Flow rules orchestrate the sequence of steps in a process, defining how work moves through different stages and assignments.

questions.question: What is the recommended way to validate data in PEGA?
options: Using validate rules and edit validate rules
questions.explanation: PEGA provides validate rules and edit validate rules for data validation, which are declarative and maintainable.

questions.question: What is a Stage in PEGA case management?
options: A major milestone in case processing
questions.explanation: A Stage represents a major milestone or phase in the case lifecycle, containing one or more processes.

questions.question: Which of the following is a declarative rule?
questions.explanation: Declare Expression is a declarative rule that automatically calculates values when inputs change, without requiring explicit execution.

questions.question: What is the purpose of class inheritance in PEGA?
options: To reuse rules and data structures
questions.explanation: Class inheritance allows reuse of rules and data structures, promoting consistency and reducing duplication across applications.
